name: Rivery
description_en:
Rivery’s current documentation is published as Boomi Data Integration and continues to reference the Rivery console. It describes source-to-target flows, reusable connections and Logic Flows that coordinate SQL, Python, REST actions and other flows. The old documentation root explicitly redirects to this named Boomi product documentation.

A useful evaluation separates data ingestion from orchestration and configuration deployment. Environment packages move configurations, while target datasets and target credentials need their own planning. The documented relationship does not establish that every Boomi product or feature is included in an existing Rivery subscription.
description_zh:
Rivery 当前文档以 Boomi Data Integration 发布，并继续引用 Rivery 控制台，描述源到目标流程、复用连接，以及协调 SQL、Python、REST 动作和其他流程的 Logic Flow。旧文档根站明确跳到该命名产品文档。

评估应区分数据摄取、编排及配置部署。环境包移动配置，目标数据集和凭据需另行规划；这条文档关系不证明既有 Rivery 订阅包含全部 Boomi 产品或功能。

core_features.explanation_en: Group SQL, Python, REST actions or other flows under sequential, parallel or conditional control.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在顺序、并行或条件控制下组合 SQL、Python、REST 动作及其他流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Deploy object configurations between environments without transferring datasets.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在环境间部署对象配置，不传输数据集。

en: Compare a small synthetic ingestion with destination rows before enabling a schedule.
Rehearse configuration deployment between two test environments without copying source credentials.
zh: 启用计划前将小型模拟摄取与目标行比较。
在两个测试环境演练配置部署，避免复制源凭据。

steps.en: Select connections, destination and load mode, then run once manually and inspect Activity.
steps.zh: 选择连接、目标和加载模式，手动运行一次并查看 Activity。

steps.en: Review edition/credits, target variables and credential-copy settings before scheduling or deployment.
steps.zh: 计划或部署前核对版本／credit、目标变量及凭据复制设置。

items.en: Deployment packages move configurations, not target datasets.
items.zh: 部署包移动配置，不移动目标数据集。

items.en: Overwrite/merge/append choices and partial external writes require separate recovery planning.
items.zh: 覆盖／合并／追加及外部部分写入需分别规划恢复。

pricing.summary_en: Base lists $0.90/BDU credit with monthly billing; BDU and RPU are identified as the same credit terminology on that page. Edition limits govern users, environments, sync rates and capabilities. Actual workload-to-credit conversion, annual quote, tax, support, full contract and Boomi/Rivery account-specific entitlement remain unverified.
pricing.summary_zh: Base 月付列每 BDU credit $0.90，页面将 BDU 与 RPU 对应为同一 credit 术语。用户、环境、同步频率及功能由版本限定。实际工作负载换算、年付报价、税费、支持、完整合同及账户权益待核。

sections.title_en: Prove one source-to-target run before scheduling
sections.title_zh: 计划运行前证明一个源到目标流程
sections.en: The getting-started guide configures connections, creates a flow, runs it manually and reviews status/logs in Activity before scheduling. Kits still require their connections and variables to be configured. Use a small synthetic source and compare destination rows with the expected output. A successful connection or installed Kit alone does not prove a complete or duplicate-free load.
sections.zh: 入门指南先配置连接和流程、手动运行并查看 Activity 状态／日志，再设置计划；Kit 也需要连接及变量配置。应使用小型模拟源比较目标行与预期输出，连接成功或 Kit 已安装不证明完整且无重复加载。

sections.title_en: Disabled or parallel steps change the result
sections.title_zh: 停用或并行步骤会改变结果
sections.en: Logic Flows can call other flows and execute SQL, Python and REST actions. A parallel container waits for its steps to finish successfully before proceeding; steps/containers may be toggled off during development. Check enabled steps and dependency order when a run appears successful but expected processing is absent. The guide does not establish a transaction covering every external side effect.
sections.zh: Logic Flow 可调用其他流程并执行 SQL、Python、REST。并行容器等待其步骤成功完成再继续，开发时可关闭步骤／容器。运行看似成功却缺少处理时，应检查启用状态及依赖顺序；指南未证明所有外部副作用处于同一事务。

sections.title_en: Choose overwrite, merge or append deliberately
sections.title_zh: 有意识地选择覆盖、合并或追加
sections.en: Logic targets support Overwrite, Upsert-Merge and Append into tables, variables, DataFrames or files. Check the selected mode and destination state before repeating a run. Orchestration does not establish automatic reversal or idempotency of partial external writes.
sections.zh: Logic 目标支持向表、变量、DataFrame 或文件执行覆盖、Upsert-Merge、追加。重复运行前应检查模式和目标状态；编排不证明外部部分写入自动回退或幂等。

sections.title_en: Move configuration without copying the wrong credentials
sections.title_zh: 移动配置时避免复制错误凭据
sections.en: The environment guide explicitly excludes datasets from deployment packages. It recommends environment-specific connection variables and leaving Add Credentials to Connections off to preserve target credentials. Review selected related objects and variable settings. The page says only Administrators manage environments but later permits Admin/Deployment Manager deployments; exact role boundaries remain a verification item.
sections.zh: 环境指南明确部署包不含数据集，建议使用环境特定连接变量，并关闭 Add Credentials to Connections 以保留目标凭据。应检查关联对象及变量设置。页面先称仅 Administrator 管理环境，后又允许 Admin／Deployment Manager 部署；具体角色边界仍待核。

sections.title_en: Usage credits and edition scope are separate
sections.title_zh: 用量 credit 与版本范围分开
sections.en: The public Base plan lists $0.90 per BDU credit for monthly billing and says BDU credits are also known as RPU credits. It includes one environment and two users; higher tiers add users/RBAC, environments and capabilities. Annual savings are described separately. Unlimited connections or usage wording does not eliminate metered charges, selected sync-frequency limits or edition-specific features.
sections.zh: 公开 Base 月付列每 BDU credit $0.90，说明 BDU 也称 RPU credit；含一环境、两用户，较高版本增加用户／RBAC、环境及能力，年付优惠另述。连接或用量“不限”措辞不会消除计量费用、同步频率或版本限制。
